[2026-09-03T00:36:18.597Z] [world] The flat silt heaves, and a hand breaks the surface, then an arm, then a face caked grey with a thousand years of it.
[2026-09-03T00:36:18.597Z] [arbiter] You've heard of these on the road: the Aetherkin, the ones the mud drowned and the Aether raised back up.

[2026-09-03T00:36:18.598Z] [world] It flinches from you and puts its back to the wall, hands raised — not a hunter, just something frightened that has forgotten everything except how to be afraid.
[2026-09-03T00:36:18.598Z] [world] You walk south through open silt. The compass tells you The Conduit Line lies further south — 4 tiles, about 10 hours of travel.

golem republish of OTA-1642 to exercise the Sentry release step (task #109)

Same bundle as c72cdbec — no app change, one note beside the stamp. The
Actions dispatch is not reachable from this session (403 on the dispatch
endpoint), and the new Sentry step only runs inside a publish, so this
markerless golem push is the measurement: the run log will say whether
SENTRY_READ_TOKEN already carries project:releases or a SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
secret is needed.
